title: Exact finite-population predictive-type certificate calibration
question: Can a simultaneous bounded-loss certificate achieve zero false authorization while retaining nontrivial coverage of margin-separated predictive types under exact finite-population truth?

hypothesis_predictions.observable: Exact finite-population risks, point estimates, simultaneous certificate intervals, typed abstention, dual-donor rescue and partial-cut controls.
hypothesis_predictions.expected: The interval certificate makes zero false authorizations, covers at least 95 percent of robust actionable systems, abstains on every exact ambiguity, and all high-fidelity rescue confirmations pass.
hypothesis_predictions.death_observation: Any false authorization, robust coverage below 0.95, any forced ambiguous system, or any registered rescue/control failure.

hypothesis_predictions.observable: The same frozen exact-risk and certificate battery.
hypothesis_predictions.expected: Finite observations cannot jointly support zero false authorization and nontrivial robust coverage, or the rescue subdomain remains uncertified.
hypothesis_predictions.death_observation: Every certificate, breadth, rescue and control gate passes in both registry splits.

allowed_observations: uniform with-replacement selection draws from the sealed finite universe

data_contract.cluster_unit: One source profile, registry split, task and replicate; source profile remains private and is not the estimand.
data_contract.split_rule: Two registry splits, nine source profiles, four tasks and six replicates. Candidate models fit only discovery; exact truth exhausts the registered finite universe; selection draws uniformly with replacement using an independent seed.
data_contract.answer_payload_rule: Profile, amplitude and exact risks remain private until adjudication; all boundary and unsupported systems remain in the denominator.

factor_design.population_truth_rule: Least-complex candidate with exact bounded risk at most 0.050 and all earlier exact risks at least 0.150; otherwise abstain.
factor_design.certificate_rule: Authorize only when the selected upper bound is at most 0.050 and all earlier lower bounds are at least 0.150.
factor_design.rescue_rule: Run rescue only when the selected risk upper bound is at most 0.025.

metrics.estimator: False authorization, robust coverage and exact-ambiguity abstention against exhaustive finite-population risk.
metrics.threshold_source: Frozen after a 72-system development probe and before formal material generation.

metrics.estimator: Point estimate and always-abstain comparison under the same exact truth.
Dual independent-donor rescue, wrong identity rejection, exact block, partial-cut residual and algebraic sentinel.
metrics.threshold_source: Frozen after a 72-system development probe and before formal material generation.

typed_gates.rule: All exact risks and classes reproduce by exhaustive finite-universe recomputation.
Zero false authorization, robust coverage at least 0.95, exact-ambiguity abstention equal to one, and both registry splits pass.
All four robust classes have at least 20 systems and certificate robust coverage strictly exceeds the zero coverage of always-abstain.
Every rescue-authorized system passes dual donor, wrong identity, block, partial-cut, manifold and negative-control gates.

budget.right_censoring_rule: Any conjunctive failure stops C014 before free-network or pretrained-model execution.

stopping_rules: No source profile, amplitude or exact risk is exposed before adjudication.
No threshold, draw count, boundary target, profile or seed changes after preregistration.
A failure closes WP01 without a larger selection-panel repair.
Algebraic replay is never counted as rescue evidence.
A pass authorizes one separately frozen free-Transformer phase and never Qwen3 directly.

authorizes_on_pass: one separately frozen cross-depth free-Transformer certificate external-validity phase
